TRAINING ONLY: includes unreviewed provisional guidance with unknown effectiveness. Check against public task/source evidence.
Use the matched guidance together where supported by the current task and source. If advice conflicts, resolve it against the concrete requirements and explain the choice; do not combine incompatible obligations.

Matched experience 7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767
7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R01 [Applicability]
Apply when delayed edits belong to a persistent document owner while the current view owns a subscription, and saving can synchronously navigate. docs/host-api.md states: "Document buffers are owned by the store BufferBank, while Badge owns only a live subscription." It also states: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously."

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R02 [Event relation]
Capture the current document buffer when accepting an edit and enqueue its text there. Retain the original document identity and persistent buffer reuse across view retirement. TASK states: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." src/coordinator.js already binds each buffer's consumer with "trailing(env.timers,120,text=>env.store.write(id,text))".

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R03 [Event relation]
Before a callback-capable save, snapshot and retire the consumed pending state so reentrant flushing cannot duplicate it and reentrant editing can create an independent subsequent burst. Reuse the existing utility's ordering in src/services.js: "const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };"

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R04 [Event relation]
Capture the departing view and revoke its current ownership before saving pending work. Complete its clearing render before callback-capable saving, or recheck authority before any remaining visible effect. Clean up the captured subscription. After retirement returns, an outer open must recheck its request identity before installing its view. Preserve nested navigation, nested edits and successor rendering.

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R05 [Preservation]
Preserve accepted text on its original document, independent pending state for different documents, buffer reuse, current-document status filtering and original rendering and payload semantics. docs/host-api.md states: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics." Preserve teardown integration in src/Workspace.vue: "onBeforeUnmount(api.dispose);"

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R06 [Exclusion]
Determine departure scheduling from the task and existing behavior separately from ownership. For this editor, flushing the captured departing buffer before retirement returns preserves synchronous store availability while allowing active edits to coalesce. Do not generalize this into a deadline for every persistent owner, cancel accepted durable edits merely because a subscription retires, or destroy the store-owned buffer during view cleanup.

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R07 [Preservation]
Keep transient preview policy separate. TASK states: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." Preserve src/services.js: "const task = trailing(timers, 40, query => publish({query}));" and "return {query: text => task.push(text), hide: () => task.cancel()};"

7cfc9280fdea6fa1491743dc5d5f18cfd5f8a3028cf1473842a4bdeaabe0e767:R08 [Verification]
Check latest-only saving after the quiet interval, subsequent bursts and empty-string edits. With pending edits, exercise switch, same-document reopen, close, dispose and Vue unmount; check original-document persistence, buffer identity, captured subscription cleanup and successor presentation. Trigger nested open and close from both timer-driven and departure-driven saves, then check final navigation, rendered output and nested edits. Confirm preview delay and hide cancellation remain intact.


Matched experience 984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa
984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa:R01 [Applicability]
A documented document buffer or other persistent owner outlives a view that owns only its live subscription.

984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa:R02 [Event relation]
Keep accepted persistent work associated with its original owner when the view detaches. Clean up the captured subscription without discarding or redirecting that work or destroying required reuse.

984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa:R03 [Preservation]
Keep current-view status filtering, document presentation and original identity/text/payload semantics. Reconcile departure scheduling using the current contract.

984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa:R04 [Exclusion]
Persistent ownership alone does not establish a before-return persistence deadline. Do not transfer durable-work retention to transient preview work.

984fb0d8e49c6024fa2f65d98389729e9a4bfb112c37d0d2b99fd37269bafafa:R05 [Verification]
Switch, close, dispose and reopen while work is pending; check original-owner persistence, subscription cleanup, independent buffers and current-view output.


Matched experience 092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce
092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce:R01 [Applicability]
Saving or subscription cleanup synchronously calls host listeners that may open another document or close the workspace.

092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce:R02 [Event relation]
Capture the old view and remove its current ownership. Finish final old-view effects, such as clearing its display, before callback-capable saving, or check authority for effects remaining after callbacks. An outer open rechecks its request identity after retirement.

092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce:R03 [Preservation]
Nested open/close, nested editing and the new view's rendering remain authoritative. Disposal also cleans up captured resources rather than clearing objects installed by a callback.

092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce:R04 [Exclusion]
Protecting only final view installation can still leave a later stale clearing render. Do not require every host to detach first; notification order follows the current contract.

092e85e09f09609c924bb3d41747f72d8a7558392eccffd0341e8694cee4fdce:R05 [Verification]
Invoke open/close inside listeners for timer-driven and departure-driven saves. Check document output, subscriptions and nested edits after the outer call returns, through both direct calls and actual unmounting.


Matched experience 380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602
380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602:R01 [Applicability]
One startup may emit multiple packets synchronously. Handling the first may hide the panel or open another visit before startup returns physical cleanup capability.

380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602:R02 [Event relation]
Check the originating visit and attempt before each packet enters decoding. Retirement immediately revokes later admission without waiting for physical listener removal.

380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602:R03 [Preservation]
Previously admitted packets settle under their separate audit and display contracts. The new visit receives bootstrap and later updates normally.

380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602:R04 [Exclusion]
Zero listeners after cleanup does not establish correctness during startup. Do not confuse previously admitted work with packets arriving after retirement.

380be240ad7e3783cd1238f8cae0230da3f5990659e5d6970f1016ac95d7b602:R05 [Verification]
Hide, switch and reopen the same source from the first synchronous callback. Emit more packets before outer startup returns, and independently check rejection of new packets and settlement of admitted packets.


Matched experience 020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892
020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892:R01 [Applicability]
Startup, cleanup, saving or publication can synchronously reenter navigation and install a new owner.

020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892:R02 [Event relation]
Capture old resources and publish retirement before callback-capable work. Establish provisional cleanup ownership before startup where needed. After callbacks, recheck request and owner identity before installing a returned handle or publishing a destination.

020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892:R03 [Preservation]
Complete cleanup for captured old resources without clearing or taking ownership of a newer visit. Preserve the documented idempotent cleanup behavior.

020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892:R04 [Exclusion]
Do not assume code after a synchronous callback still owns the current view. Do not hard-code one cleanup ordering when the current API requires a different order; guard remaining effects.

020a49e031c6debee42b6737e3b521faebbb5394e908c26ddf24d6e2fc2d9892:R05 [Verification]
Exercise hide, switch and dispose inside startup, detachment and saving; check both resulting view and resource ownership after the outer call returns.
